_about: Sourced values added on top of the generated catalog by scripts/seed_catalog.py (SPEC §20.7; approved 2026-10-19). Prices: BikeDekho New Delhi pages; every on-road row's parts add up to its total. Estimates are flagged and never spoken. Applied before _price_overrides.json, so product-owner decisions win.

left_empty.sp-125/25-year Anniversary Edition: not listed on BikeDekho, BikeWale or ZigWheels Delhi pages
left_empty.rebel-500 on-road: no Delhi price: sold through BigWing Topline in Gurugram, Mumbai and Bengaluru
left_empty.rebel-500/E-Clutch: not launched in India (the May 2025 launch has one variant)
left_empty.activa-e/qc1/qc3 on-road: kept BikeWale's rows: they subtract the PM E-Drive subsidy (still in force, extended to March 2028), BikeDekho's don't; RoadSync Duo breakdown left empty (sources ~9,000 apart)
